name: Cypreste Superlogica - Aluguel AP Praia da Costa

steps.description: Aguardar pagina de senha carregar (two-page login)
Aguardar carregamento da grid de faturas (rows ou mensagem vazio)
Extrair primeira fatura pendente e link da segunda via via JavaScript

month.script: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); if (!row) return ''; const text = row.textContent || ''; const m = text.match(/venc\.?\s*em\s*(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})/i); return m ? `${m[2]}/${m[3]}` : ''; })()

amount.script: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); if (!row) return ''; const amount = row.querySelector('.numeric, td:nth-child(2)'); const text = amount ? amount.textContent : (row.textContent || ''); const m = text.match(/([0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{3})*,[0-9]{2})/); return m ? m[1] : ''; })()

due_date.script: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); if (!row) return ''; const text = row.textContent || ''; const m = text.match(/venc\.?\s*em\s*(\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4})/i); return m ? m[1] : ''; })()

status.script: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); if (!row) return 'no_pending_bills'; const text = row.textContent || ''; const m = text.match(/(Pendente|Vencida|Liquidada|Em aberto)/i); return m ? m[1] : 'Pendente'; })()

boleto_url.script: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); if (!row) return ''; const link = row.querySelector('a[href*="cobranca"], a[href*="boleto"], a[href*="segunda"]'); return link ? link.href : ''; })()

steps.description: Extrair todas as faturas pendentes via JavaScript

all_bills.script: (() => { const emptyRow = document.querySelector('tr.Superlogica_Js_Grid_MsgVazio'); if (emptyRow && emptyRow.offsetParent !== null) return JSON.stringify([]); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr.Superlogica_Js_Template_Row'); const bills = []; rows.forEach(row => { const text = row.textContent || ''; const amountCell = row.querySelector('.numeric, td:nth-child(2)'); const amountText = amountCell ? amountCell.textContent || '' : text; const amountMatch = amountText.match(/([0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{3})*,[0-9]{2})/); const dateMatch = text.match(/venc\.?\s*em\s*(\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4})/i); const boletoLink = row.querySelector('a[href*="cobranca"], a[href*="boleto"], a[href*="segunda"]'); bills.push({ description: text.trim(), amount: amountMatch ? amountMatch[1] : null, due_date: dateMatch ? dateMatch[1] : null, boleto_url: boletoLink?.href || null, status: /vencida/i.test(text) ? 'Vencida' : 'Pendente' }); }); return JSON.stringify(bills); })()

steps.description: Abrir segunda via da fatura para extrair competencia e linha digitavel
Aguardar pagina da fatura/segunda via carregar
Extrair dados completos da fatura Superlogica

reference_month.script: (() => { const text = document.body?.innerText || ''; const comp = text.match(/COMPET[ÊE]NCIA:\s*(\d{2}\/\d{4})/i); if (comp) return comp[1]; const due = text.match(/VENCIMENTO:\s*(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})/i); return due ? `${due[2]}/${due[3]}` : ''; })()

due_date.script: (() => { const direct = document.querySelector('#DT_VENCIMENTO_FATURA'); const text = direct?.textContent || document.body?.innerText || ''; const m = text.match(/(\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4})/); return m ? m[1] : ''; })()

amount.script: (() => { const hidden = document.querySelector('#valorBoleto'); if (hidden?.value) return hidden.value; const text = document.body?.innerText || ''; const m = text.match(/VALOR\s*ATUALIZADO:\s*R\$\s*([0-9.]+,[0-9]{2})/i) || text.match(/R\$\s*([0-9.]+,[0-9]{2})/); return m ? m[1] : ''; })()

status.script: (() => { const body = document.body; const text = body?.innerText || ''; if (body?.classList?.contains('paga') || /liquidada|pago/i.test(text)) return 'Liquidada'; return 'Pendente'; })()

barcode.script: (() => { const hidden = document.querySelector('#linha_digitavel_boleto'); if (hidden?.value) return hidden.value.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const textarea = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('textarea')).find(el => /\d{5}/.test(el.value || '')); if (textarea?.value) return textarea.value.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const text = document.body?.innerText || ''; const barcodeMatch = text.match(/(\d{5}\.\d{5}\s*\d{5}\.\d{6}\s*\d{5}\.\d{6}\s*\d\s*\d{14})/); if (barcodeMatch) return barcodeMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const numericMatch = text.match(/\b(\d{47,48})\b/); return numericMatch ? numericMatch[1] : ''; })()

issuer.script: (() => { const cedente = document.querySelector('#cedenteRaw'); return cedente?.textContent?.trim() || 'Cypreste Imoveis'; })()

notes: Cypreste/Superlogica nao tem portal de pagamento online com cartao
Boleto deve ser pago manualmente via app do banco (Nubank, Inter, etc.)
O sistema extrai linha digitavel quando disponivel no DOM e envia notificacao
Se a linha nao estiver no DOM, acessar o link do boleto no portal
Portal Superlogica - Area do Cliente (Imobiliaria Cypreste)
Login TWO-PAGE: pagina 1 pede email (input#email + input#salvar), redirect para pagina 2 com senha
Celulas pendentes: td Botoes (links boleto/recibo), td Empresa (descricao+datas), td ValorCorrigido (valor+status)
Historico descricao: 'Fatura liquidada em DD/MM/YYYY (com venc. em DD/MM/YYYY)'
Credenciais 1Password: 'Cypreste Superlogica' vault FinanApp (senha label: senha_confirmacao)
